milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the blue glazed terracotta block (placed at relative [4, 0, 5] on the front face of the oak planks structure) and face toward it, demonstrating they have visually located the distinctive blue swirling pattern block. max_distance=16 allows detection from reasonable viewing range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the block.
